entities.name: Russell A. Kirsch
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Russell A. Kirsch was an American engineer at the National Bureau of Standards. He was recognized as the developer of the first digital image scanner, and subsequently scanned the world's first digital photograph – an image of his infant son.
